messages.subject: using xlim in plot.scanone()
parts:
Hello all,

This might be super obvious but I can't figure out how to use the xlim
function in plot.scanone(). I want to show the lod graph between 50
and 100 cm only for a single chromosome.

Any help would be appreciated

-T

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] using xlim in plot.scanone()
parts:
It should work to just include it in the call. Consider the following.
You might want to use xaxs="i" (see the help file for the par function).

data(hyper)
hyper <- calc.genoprob(hyper, step=1)
out <- scanone(hyper)
plot(out, chr=1, xlim=c(20,60))
plot(out, chr=1, xlim=c(20,60), xaxs="i")

cheers,
karl
